args: Analyze the OFF face parsing logic in assimp/code/AssetLib/OFF/OFFLoader.cpp, especially InternReadFile and GetNextLine failure during the declared face loop. What is the project's preferred malformed-input error mechanism, and would throwing DeadlyImportError on premature EOF be safe and consistent? Also identify any cleanup/ownership implications if parsing throws after allocating mesh faces.

The reported ASan crash arises because an OFF file declares more faces than it supplies. InternReadFile allocates mesh->mFaces and sets mNumFaces to the declaration, but on GetNextLine failure it logs and breaks, leaving default aiFace objects with mNumIndices zero. TargetRealtime_Quality later reaches SortByPTypeProcess and indexes aiNumPerPType[pFirstFace->mNumIndices - 1], causing unsigned underflow and a wild write. The PoC includes embedded NUL bytes and at least one parsed polygon. I am considering rejecting truncated OFF input immediately at the face loop rather than shrinking the mesh, because the declared topology is incomplete and this should fix the root cause while preserving invariants.
